cohort: The study included 2,195 primigravidae women undergoing induction of labor for all indications, excluding those with breech deliveries, stillbirths, multiple pregnancies, and elective caesarean sections.
finding: Increasing maternal age in primigravidae women undergoing induction of labor may lead to a higher caesarean section delivery rate, but without compromising the neonatal outcome.
mod_finding: Increasing maternal age was associated with a higher caesarean section delivery rate in primigravidae women undergoing induction of labour.
